thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 12/21-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 122-day SMA regime filter on AMAT, CRM, INTU, AAPL, LRCX, KLAC, ADBE, CSCO, with a 10% stop and a 63-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(122) and ema(12) crosses_above ema(21)
